row.category: Vertical SaaS (Healthcare, Education, Real Estate, Construction, Field Service)
row.evidence: Envoy's help centre lists Directory Sync (Okta, Entra, OneLogin, Centrify and Sailpoint, all "SCIM standard") as "Premium & Enterprise Plans only", and the pricing page puts "SSO & employee directory integrations" on Premium, the cheapest paid Visitors plan; SCIM provisioning of admin roles is Enterprise-only.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to free because the pricing model changed: envoy.com/pricing no longer shows the June Workplace Standard $3 / Premium $5 / Premium Plus $7 per-active-user tiers (those prices are dropped, no first-party source now). Visitors is now Basic (free, up to 50 employees), Premium $362/location/mo billed annually and Enterprise (custom pricing); employee directory SCIM sync is on Premium and Enterprise, so it sits on the cheapest paid tier. SCIM-based admin role provisioning is Enterprise-only (help articles still say 'Visitors Enterprise and Workplace Premium Plus'). Per-location pricing, so per-user fields are null. Other products are single-tier and exclude a platform fee: Response $2/user/mo, Reservations $5/bookable resource/mo, Screens $12/device/mo, Deliveries $250/delivery location/mo.

plans.name: Basic
plans.price_text: Free (limited features, up to 50 employees, 100 entries/month)

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per-location pricing. Employee directory SCIM sync included; SCIM admin-role provisioning is not.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Adds SCIM provisioning of admin roles and custom admin roles.

auth.token_source: Envoy dashboard > Integrations > Directory and SSO > Directory settings > Install (IdP) > OAuth Bearer Token (Regenerate available)

endpoints.notes: Users and Groups inferred from the documented user and group-push provisioning; no SCIM endpoint reference is published.

operations.notes: Envoy's Entra article describes PATCH update requests. OneLogin guide sets the deprovision action to 'Delete User'.

deprovision.notes: Okta/Sailpoint 'deactivate' and OneLogin 'Delete User' are documented, but not what Envoy does with the employee record.

custom.how: Envoy extension urn:scim:schemas:extension:envoy:core:1.0:User (Entra: urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:envoy:core:1.0:User) with defaultLocationName (primary location), remoteStatus and managerDisplayName (manager email; Okta/Sailpoint); assistants via an Okta expression mapping.

attributes.notes: Group attribute names are not listed by Envoy; group push is documented.

roles.how: Enterprise only: IdP groups pushed to Envoy are mapped in Employee directory > Admin roles > Sync settings to one location role (Location admin, Front desk admin, Deliveries, Security admin) and one company role (Global admin, Billing admin).

limitations.text: SCIM admin-role provisioning is Enterprise-only (help articles also name 'Workplace Premium Plus').
Okta app must be set to the US region even for EU accounts or SCIM will not work.
Users without a primary email are not synced; matching is on primary email; SCIM sync takes over and deletes manual directory entries.
Entra ID does not support nested groups for SCIM provisioning or Envoy's assistant feature.
Regenerating the bearer token invalidates the old token immediately.

capabilities.notes: Current API is read-only for employees; a legacy CSV import endpoint replaces the directory.

endpoints.purpose: Fetch a list of Employees (filter by name/email)
Look up an Employee by ID
Import Employees Records via CSV (app.envoy.com, legacy)

webhooks_user_events.notes: Event catalogue covers entries, invites and blocklists (e.g. employee_entry_sign_in, employee_invite_created); no directory create/delete events listed.

limitations.text: No documented endpoints to create, update or delete individual employees; webhooks cover visitor/employee entries and invites.

okta.notes: Envoy (SCIM 2.0) OIN app; SAML 2.0 sign-on per Envoy's guide.

google.notes: Envoy-run Google Workspace directory sync every 24 hours; Google catalogue page not checked.

onelogin.notes: From Envoy's own OneLogin guide (Envoy (SAML2.0, provisioning) app).

fallbacks.other_sync: Google Workspace directory sync (every 24h), Active Directory cron script, LDAP, HRIS

conflicts.text: The pricing comparison lists SCIM only in the Enterprise-only row 'Automatically provision admin and employee roles via SCIM', while help articles say SCIM directory sync is on Premium & Enterprise and the pricing page gives 'SSO & employee directory integrations' to Premium.
Help articles say admin-role SCIM provisioning is for 'Visitors Enterprise and Workplace Premium Plus', but the pricing page no longer lists Workplace tiers.

open_questions: What deprovisioning does to the Envoy employee record (deactivate vs delete), and whether it ends sessions or frees anything billable, is not documented.
Whether SAML must be set up before SCIM is not stated.
SCIM endpoint reference (ServiceProviderConfig, filtering, pagination, rate limits) is not published.
Whether SAML sign-in creates users just-in-time is not documented (NameID must match an existing directory email).
No audit-log API found; dashboard activity log exists on Enterprise.
Workplace (Premium Plus) tiers named in help articles are absent from the pricing page; their current prices are unknown.
Google Workspace catalogue entry for Envoy not checked.
